title: Name the gravity
prompt: 980 is how fast the robot falls. Name it `GRAVITY` and use the name in the calculation.
starter:
func solve(velocity, seconds) -> float:
	return velocity + 980 * seconds

tests.name: From 0, one second of gravity is 980

hints: Declare the constant first, then swap the number for the name.
Only the name changes in the maths.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.
